tools.name: lls
tools.title: LLS service
tools.description: Launch, inspect, gracefully shut down or restart LLS directly, without Visual Studio. Open help path 'lls'.

configuration.description: Explicit service instance; independent of this connector's build.

executable.description: Full lls.exe or lrt.exe path, required for launch/restart. Uses its directory for catalogs and lls.dll. Restart must match the running host path.

tools.name: tree
tools.title: Directory tree
tools.description: Scan a directory natively; return ASCII or compact JSON with file byte sizes. No shell or child process.

format.description: JSON text contains root, columns, depth-first entries, truncated and incomplete.

maxDepth.description: Maximum directory levels to list; depth cutoffs are marked.

tools.name: help
tools.title: Help
tools.description: Browse help indexes and command details by path. Empty path opens the root.

path.description: Full space-separated topic path, e.g. vs build or shell cmd. Omit for root.

tools.name: vs
tools.title: Visual Studio
tools.description: Visual Studio command tree: build, launch, list, ping, close and restart. Open help path 'vs' for the index.

solution.description: Exact solution path; required for build/launch. Forward slashes.

msbuild.description: Full MSBuild executable path using forward slashes; required for build.

project.description: Required for build/launch. Build: solution target. Launch: unique project name or DTE UniqueName.

configuration.description: Exact solution Configuration|Platform; required for build/launch.

instance.description: IDE process ID from vs list. Required for ping/close/restart; launch may select an existing instance.

devenv.description: Caller-supplied devenv.exe path to open a new IDE when launch omits instance. No installation-path guessing.

tools.name: cmd
tools.title: Command Prompt
tools.description: Execute caller-supplied cmd code. Optional elevation requests UAC; not a sandbox.

command.description: Shell command/script. Normal calls wait and return combined stdout/stderr and exit code.

elevated.description: Request Windows UAC elevation. Launch-only: no captured output or completion status.

tools.name: powershell
tools.title: PowerShell
tools.description: Execute caller-supplied powershell code. Optional elevation requests UAC; not a sandbox.

command.description: Shell command/script. Normal calls wait and return combined stdout/stderr and exit code.

elevated.description: Request Windows UAC elevation. Launch-only: no captured output or completion status.

tools.name: wsl
tools.title: WSL Linux
tools.description: Run /bin/sh in the installed default WSL distribution as its configured user. Does not install or convert WSL.

command.description: Shell command/script. Normal calls wait and return combined stdout/stderr and exit code.

tools.name: status
tools.title: Build status
tools.description: Query an original vs request id without waiting for the worker. Returns queued/executing/completed, elapsedMs since acceptance, operation status and known child exitCode (otherwise null). Executing does not prove OS liveness or progress. Records last for this server session; use unique vs request ids.

id.description: Original vs JSON-RPC request id; not a PID.
